tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Find Projects tracked by AIXBT. Filter by ID, slug, name, ticker, X handle, chain, category, asset type, contract address, or minimum trend. Results are sorted by trend by default; use cursor for the next page.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get a Project by ID or slug, including its current trend, rank, recent Intel, related Projects, and 24-hour trend change when available. Related Projects are based on co-mentions, not partnerships or endorsements.

tools.name: get_project_series
tools.description: Get trend or rank history for a Project by ID or slug. Trend returns hourly points; rank returns recorded rank changes and null while unranked. Optionally set a time window.

tools.name: list_intel
tools.description: Search and filter evidence-graded crypto developments. Search by Project, ticker, X handle, contract address, chain, or any keywords; combine it with Project, cluster, category, grade, sentiment, official-source, or time filters. Results explain why they matched. When responsiveness bounds a search,

tools.name: get_intel
tools.description: Get one Intel item by ID, including its evidence grade, Project, sources, timestamps, audience clusters, and configurable activity rows.

tools.name: list_reports
tools.description: List metadata and previews for AIXBT's latest published report on each Topic, ordered by the most recent publication or revision. Filter by Topic or Project. Requires a credential; use get_report for the full report.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Get a published report by ID, including its full text, sources, and publication evidence when available. Requires a credential with the topic-reports entitlement. If the report was superseded, use list_reports to find the current ID.

tools.name: get_vocabulary
tools.description: Get the current allowed values for AIXBT filters, including grades, sentiments, sort fields, activity modes, universes, asset types, categories, chains, and alert settings.

tools.name: list_clusters
tools.description: List the community groups AIXBT uses to show which audiences are driving attention across Topics and Intel. Optionally filter by universe.

tools.name: me
tools.description: Show the current credential's identity, entitlements, rate limits, and history access. Use this before gated or historical requests.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List the current crypto Topic leaderboard, refreshed hourly. Results include trend, 24-hour post and author counts, audience clusters, and available report metadata. Provide projectId to return Topics associated with one Project. Available without a credential.

tools.name: get_topic
tools.description: Get one current Topic by ID, including its stance history. Available without a credential. A Topic that has left the leaderboard returns not_current; use list_topics for current IDs.

tools.name: get_topic_series
tools.description: Get measurement history for a Topic. Trend returns hourly points; rank returns recorded rank changes and null while unranked. Optionally set a time window. Requires OAuth or an AIXBT API key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_topics · Private data: list_reports, get_report, me, list_topics, get_topic, get_topic_series · Public sink: list_topics.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_topics · Private data: list_reports, get_report, me, list_topics, get_topic, get_topic_series · Public sink: list_topics

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
